g.text: Identify patient and choose service/professional/date range
filter by future start and full service duration
Book selected slot for clinic/phone request
validate future and full duration inline
[channel, future start or full-duration validation fails]
Show conflict; search again if needed
validate referral existence, activity, patient and targets
reserve(patient, service, slot, LOCATION, channel, referralId)
PoC simplifies O03: slotId supplies professional/location/dateTime; one clinic.
Resources, waitingListEntryID and real auth/audit are NOT implemented here.
Their analysis contracts are deferred; this diagram traces the existing Java subset.
